resources.string: Search readable text across your stored documents
On-device AI · choose a document for cited facts
Experimental local AI. Replies can be wrong. General chat cannot read your vault or perform actions.
Questions use relevant source excerpts on this device. AI explanations can be wrong; check the quoted text and source pages.
What would you like to ask?
Type a message for the local model, or choose a document or “Ask my documents” above to ask about your stored text.
Chat stays in memory and clears when the vault locks. Only recent messages are used for context. Nothing is sent to a server.
What do my documents say about cancellation?

Printed policy and invoice facts use direct extraction. Other questions and summaries use a local model with up to four source excerpts. Large scopes are partial: at most 16 documents and 200,000 text characters are read after a bounded local search.
Working on this device. A slow reply can take a few minutes. Cancellation may wait for native processing to return.
Set up the compact local model for conversation and document explanations. Exact printed facts and relevant excerpts can still be read without it.
Changing the source starts a new chat so documents and previous replies stay separate.
Import a document first to ask about its facts.
